mira: Quick question on flag precedence — if a flag is set at the route to true but the model config explicitly disables it, which wins? Trying to finalize a rollout plan for model-specific quantization toggle.
sam: Model-level wins — precedence is (most specific) model > route > project > org (least specific). So an explicit model=false will override route=true. :thumbsup:
leo: Small nuance: explicit vs inherited. If model has no entry, it inherits the route/project/org value. If model sets an explicit null or `inherit: true` we treat it as absent.
dk: Also remember we have some org-level safety flags marked `overridable: false` — those cannot be overridden by lower scopes unless org explicitly flips the metadata.
mira: Good to know. Is there a way to get the full resolution chain for a given request? Want to paste it into the rollout doc so PMs understand why rw-3b is excluded.
sam: Yep, use the CLI slash helper or internal endpoint: `/flag-resolve <org>/<project>/<route>?model=<model>`. It returns the chain + metadata. Example output: 
```
/flag-resolve redwood/inference/embeddings?model=rw-3b
=> {
  "org": "true",
  "project": "true",
  "route": "true",
  "model": "false (explicit)",
  "resolved": "false",
  "overridable": "true"
}
```
leo: Note: deploy-bot will also warn if you attempt a conflicting change (route flip while a model explicit override exists). It pings owners to avoid accidental breakage.
deploy-bot: Attempted change to flag `quantize_v2` at route level detected. Model-level explicit override exists for `rw-3b`. @mira please confirm before proceeding.
mira: Thanks — I'll coordinate with the model owners. For the canary we want to enable at the route level but exclude `rw-3b`. Plan: route=true, model(rw-3b)=false. Good?
sam: That works. One more thing about audiences: canary audiences are only supported at route or project level today; we don't have per-model audiences. So set `route.canary.audience = "beta_5pct"` and keep model override boolean.
canary-bot: Created audience "beta_5pct" (5% users). Attached to route `inference/embeddings`.
dk: Guardrail reminder: add a rollback/fallback policy on the route so if errors spike you auto-fallback to the safer model or org default. E.g. `route.policy = {"rollback_threshold":"3%/10m","fail_open":false}`.
mira: Noted — I'll add that to the rollout PR. Also where do we set `overridable` for a flag? Org-level metadata?
sam: Yes — `flag.metadata.overridable: true|false`. Default true for normal features, false for safety-critical flags. Only org admins can change that field.
leo: FYI when you `infra flags export` you'll get `scope`, `explicit`, `inherited_from`, `overridable` fields — useful for the PR checklist.
mira: Great, I'll update the PR with the resolve output and policy snippet, then assign reviews. @sam can you eyeball the CLI examples when I push?
sam: Sure — ping me when it's up. :rocket:
